name: HMRC monthly exchange rates
description: Reads HMRC's published monthly exchange rates from the UK Trade Tariff service, so Rackflow can show the VAT of a UK VAT invoice in another currency in sterling.
author: Rackflow

settings.label: Trade Tariff address
settings.help: The address of the UK Trade Tariff service. The plugin reads /api/v2/exchange_rates/files/monthly_xml_<year>-<month>.xml from it.

provides.label: HMRC monthly exchange rates
provides.description: HMRC's monthly rates for customs and VAT, in currency units per GBP 1.
